units.source_text: 急急忙忙地赶路，黄昏过后到达宇治。

en.t: They hurried along the road and reached Uji after dusk.

units.source_text: 大内记先去找一个熟悉内情的、薰大将的家臣，向他探听情况，

en.t: The Senior Recorder first went to find one of Captain Kaoru's retainers who knew the inside circumstances and asked him about the situation,

units.source_text: 避开了值夜人所在之处，走到西面围着苇垣的地方，

en.t: then avoided the place where the night watchmen were stationed and went to the western side enclosed by a reed fence,

units.source_text: 把苇垣稍稍拆毁些，钻了进去。

en.t: broke a little of the reed fence apart, and slipped inside.

units.source_text: 他以前不曾到过这地方，不免有些慌张。

en.t: He had never been to this place before, so he could not help feeling somewhat flustered.

units.source_text: 幸而这是人迹罕到之处，无人注目。

en.t: Fortunately, it was a rarely visited spot, and no one noticed him.

units.source_text: 他摸索前进，但见正殿南面尚有幽暗的灯光，

en.t: He felt his way forward and saw that a dim light still shone on the south side of the main hall,

units.source_text: 里面还有轻微的人声。

en.t: and faint human voices could still be heard inside.

units.source_text: 他就回到外面，报告匂亲王：“她们还没有睡，您可以从这里进去。”

en.t: He returned outside and reported to Prince Niou, "They have not gone to sleep yet; you can go in from here."

units.source_text: 便替他带路。

en.t: Then he led the way for him.

units.source_text: 匂亲王走进里面，一脚跨到正殿廊上，看见格子窗有隙缝。

en.t: Prince Niou went inside, stepped with one foot onto the gallery of the main hall, and saw a gap in the lattice window.

units.source_text: 但挂在那里的伊豫帘子簌簌地响，他不由得屏住了呼吸。

en.t: But the Iyo blind hanging there rustled softly, and he instinctively held his breath.

units.source_text: 这屋子虽是新造且又很讲究的，但因竣工不久，有些隙缝尚未补好。

en.t: Although the house was newly built and very carefully made, it had only recently been finished, and some gaps had not yet been repaired.

units.source_text: 侍女们以为谁也不会到这里来窥探，毫不戒备，那些窟窿也不填塞。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting assumed that no one would come here to spy, so they were completely off guard and had not blocked up the holes.

units.source_text: 匂亲王向内窥看，但见帷屏的垂布撩起在一边，灯火点亮着，

en.t: Prince Niou peered inside and saw that the hanging cloth of a screen had been lifted to one side and the lamps were lit,

units.source_text: 有三四个侍女正在缝纫，还有一个相貌美好的女童正在搓线。

en.t: with three or four ladies-in-waiting sewing, and a pretty young girl twisting thread.

units.source_text: 匂亲王首先注目这女童，记得这面庞正是上次在二条院灯光之下看见过的。

en.t: Prince Niou first fixed his attention on this young girl, remembering that her face was the very one he had seen last time under the lamplight at Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 但又疑心也许看错。

en.t: Yet he also wondered whether he might have mistaken her.

units.source_text: 又见那时看到的一个侍女，名字也叫作右近的，也在那里。

en.t: He also saw a lady-in-waiting he had seen then, one named Ukon, who was there as well.

units.source_text: 浮舟以肘作枕，斜倚在那里凝望着灯火。

en.t: Ukifune rested her head on her elbow, leaned there at an angle, and gazed at the lamplight.

units.source_text: 那眉梢眼角和低垂的额发非常高尚优雅，与二女公子十分肖似。

en.t: The line of her brows, the corners of her eyes, and the low-hanging hair over her forehead were very noble and elegant, and closely resembled the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 右近一面折叠手中的缝物，一面说道：“小姐倘赴石山进香，要好几天才回来呢。

en.t: As Ukon folded the sewing in her hands, she said, "If our young lady goes to worship at Ishiyama, it will take several days before she returns.

units.source_text: 昨天我听京中的使者说：‘过了地方官任免期之后，二月初一左右，大将一定到这里来。’

en.t: Yesterday I heard from a messenger from the capital, 'After the period for appointing and dismissing provincial officials has passed, around the first day of the second month, the Captain is sure to come here.'

units.source_text: 大将给小姐的信上怎么说的？”

en.t: What did the Captain say in his letter to you, my lady?"

units.source_text: 浮舟不答，脸上愁容可掬。

en.t: Ukifune did not answer, and her face was full of sorrow.

units.source_text: 右近又说：“真不凑巧，好像故意逃避似的，倒很不好意思。”

en.t: Ukon continued, "It is truly unfortunate; it will look as though you were avoiding him on purpose, which is rather embarrassing."

units.source_text: 坐在右近对面的侍女说：“小姐是去进香的，只要写一封信告诉大将就好了。

en.t: The lady-in-waiting seated opposite Ukon said, "Our young lady is going on a pilgrimage, so it would be enough simply to write a letter and tell the Captain.

units.source_text: 怎么可以轻易地出门，不声不响地逃避呢？

en.t: How could she lightly go out and silently seem to run away?

units.source_text: 进香之后，不要到常陆守夫人家耽搁，立刻回到这里吧。

en.t: After the pilgrimage, she should not linger at the Hitachi Governor's wife's house, but return here at once.

units.source_text: 这里虽然寂寞，倒安逸自在，可悠闲度日。

en.t: Although it is lonely here, it is peaceful and free, and one can pass the days at leisure.

units.source_text: 在京中反而好像做客似的。”

en.t: In the capital, by contrast, one feels almost like a guest."

units.source_text: 另一侍女说：“还不如暂不出门，在这里等待大将回来，又是安稳，又是得体。

en.t: Another lady-in-waiting said, "It would be better not to go out for the time being, but to wait here for the Captain to return; that would be both secure and proper.

units.source_text: 不久大将迎接小姐进京之后，尽可从从容容地去探望常陆守夫人。

en.t: Before long, after the Captain escorts our young lady to the capital, she can go at her ease to visit the Hitachi Governor's wife.

units.source_text: 那位乳母真性急，何必匆匆忙忙地劝请进香呢？

en.t: That nurse is truly impatient; why must she so hurriedly urge this pilgrimage?

units.source_text: 自古至今，凡事都要有耐性，结果才是幸福的。”

en.t: From ancient times to now, everything requires patience, and only then does the outcome bring happiness."

units.source_text: 右近说：“为什么不阻止乳母呢？

en.t: Ukon said, "Why does no one stop the nurse?

units.source_text: 一个人年纪老了，头脑往往不清。”

en.t: When people grow old, their minds often become unclear."

units.source_text: 她们在怪怨那乳母。

en.t: They were blaming that nurse.

units.source_text: 匂亲王记得那天邂逅遇见浮舟时，旁边确有一个很讨厌的老婆子，

en.t: Prince Niou remembered that when he had happened to meet Ukifune that day, there had indeed been a very disagreeable old woman beside her,

units.source_text: 觉得好像是梦中见过的。

en.t: and it seemed to him as though he had seen her in a dream.

units.source_text: 侍女们信口乱谈，说的话甚至刺耳难闻。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting chattered carelessly, and some of what they said was even harsh to hear.

units.source_text: 有一人说：“二条院的匂亲王夫人真好福气！

en.t: One of them said, "How fortunate Prince Niou's wife at Nijo-in is!

units.source_text: 六条院左大臣威势如此盛大，待女婿如此优厚，

en.t: The Minister of the Left at Rokujo-in has such great power and treats his son-in-law with such generosity,

units.source_text: 然而二条院这位夫人生了小公子之后，亲王对她比六条院那位夫人重视得多了。

en.t: and yet after this lady at Nijo-in gave birth to a young son, the Prince has come to value her far more than the lady at Rokujo-in.

units.source_text: 这也是因为她身边没有像这里的乳母那样多管闲事的人，

en.t: That is also because she has no meddlesome person around her like the nurse here,

units.source_text: 所以夫人可以自由自在，贤明地安排一切事情。”

en.t: so the lady can act freely and arrange everything wisely."

units.source_text: 又一人说：“我们这里，只要大将真心宠爱我家小姐，永不变心，

en.t: Another said, "As for us here, as long as the Captain truly loves our young lady and never changes his heart,

units.source_text: 那么我家小姐也不会赶不上二条院夫人。”

en.t: then our young lady will not fall short of the lady at Nijo-in either."

units.source_text: 浮舟稍稍抬起身来，说道：“你们说这些话多难听啊！

en.t: Ukifune raised herself slightly and said, "How unpleasant these things you are saying sound!

units.source_text: 倘是别人，由你们去说赶得上赶不上，

en.t: If it were someone else, you might talk as you please about whether I could match her or not,

units.source_text: 对二条院夫人，你们千万不要说这种话。

en.t: but about the lady at Nijo-in, you must never say such things.

units.source_text: 如果被她听到了，多难为情！”

en.t: If she heard it, how embarrassing it would be!"

units.source_text: 匂亲王听了这话，想道：“不知这女子和我家夫人有什么亲戚关系？

en.t: When Prince Niou heard this, he thought, "I wonder what kinship this woman has with my wife.

units.source_text: 相貌确是非常肖似的。”

en.t: Their looks are certainly very much alike."

units.source_text: 他就在心中把两人比较，觉得在优雅高贵方面，二女公子比此人占胜得多；

en.t: In his mind he compared the two and felt that in elegance and nobility, the Second Princess was far superior to this woman;

units.source_text: 此人只是一味娇艳，五官生得清丽可爱。

en.t: this woman was simply charming and alluring, with features that were clear, delicate, and lovely.

units.source_text: 照匂亲王的习性，凡是魂思梦想地要见的人，一旦果然见到了，

en.t: Given Prince Niou's nature, whenever he actually met someone he had longed to see even in his dreams,

units.source_text: 即使其人确有缺点，也决不肯轻易放过。

en.t: even if that person truly had flaws, he would never easily let her go.

units.source_text: 何况现在已把这浮舟看得清清楚楚，他心中所计虑的只是如何能把这人占为己有。

en.t: Now that he had seen Ukifune so clearly, all he could think about was how to make her his own.

units.source_text: 他想：“看样子她就要出门。

en.t: He thought, "It looks as though she is about to go away.

units.source_text: 又好像是有母亲的。

en.t: It also seems that she has a mother.

units.source_text: 那么除了此地之外，还能向哪里去寻找她呢？

en.t: If so, where besides this place could I go to look for her?

units.source_text: 今夜有什么办法可以到手呢？”

en.t: Is there any way tonight that I can obtain her?"

units.source_text: 此时他已魂不附体，只管向洞内窥视。

en.t: By this time he was beside himself and did nothing but peer through the hole.
